text: {"name": "hci_cmd_send_vendor", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Sends or dispatches a vendor HCI command by selecting a table entry from the low byte of a2, optionally clearing associated IRQs, and processing the chosen payload list or fallback list through list_process_count.", "subsystem": "hci", "var_renames": {"a1": "cmd_packet", "a2": "packed_vendor_selector", "v2": "status_pptr", "v4": "table_index", "v5": "sub_index", "v6": "table_base", "v7": "entry_offset", "v8": "primary_list", "v9": "table_entry", "v10": "selected_node", "v12": "fallback_list", "result": "list_status"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 0, "meaning": "vendor table entry primary payload list pointer"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "vendor table entry fallback payload list pointer"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "vendor table entry pointer to uint16 node-offset array"}, {"offset": 14, "meaning": "vendor table entry threshold/limit for high-byte sub_index"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "list node count passed to list_process_count"}]}
